symptom: A Starlark rule could not read a button's caption or tooltip: widgets() had neither, and the strings() caption row's element_id was the button's Forms$ClientTemplate, the confirmation rows' a Forms$ConfirmationInfo, so no text could be tied to a widget id.
cause: The widget walk never read the widget's own texts, and the translations walk recorded only a text's direct owner.
insight: The storage key is CaptionTemplate, not Caption, for a button: the first version read Caption, passed a unit test built on the assumed key, and gave 0 of 73 captions on CitrusGrove. Before writing a raw-BSON reader, tally the real (parent $Type, key) pairs from `mxcli bson dump --format ndsl` over every page, snippet and layout -- it showed CaptionTemplate (buttons), Caption (labels), Content (dynamic text) and LabelTemplate (inputs) in one pass. Second trap: rebuilding mxcli without a schema bump reused the cached catalog, so the fixed build still showed 0 until `refresh catalog full force`. Coverage measured after: 66/73 buttons have a caption (the 7 are icon-only, empty in storage), 739/810 page texts carry a widget_id, the 71 others are exactly the page titles, and the 7 that name no widgets() row are tab page captions.
